24 October 2026: constraint audits exhaust the CF1 window
A fresh, source-bound singleton run localized the 80-trip constructive baseline failure. Charging preparation began at 2.255 seconds with a 6-second window. Model building took 2.170 seconds; the first full inventory took 2.003 seconds, including 1.709 seconds reading physical constraint rows. The second row inspection exhausted the window after another 1.715 seconds. No CF1 charging optimization started. The run therefore supplies no charging-infeasibility or CF1-quality result.

The fallback full solver retained a physically replay-valid 24-vehicle plan with bill 3386.201202. Independent analysis checked the exact bills, captures and unrestricted-bound scope. Output and acknowledgment were timely at about 50.889 seconds, and the owned worker was reaped. The required CF1 charging/warm-start path still failed qualification; no retry, replacement timetable, recovery suffix, model training or matched comparison was run.

Independent review recommends separating correctness-mechanism qualification from method performance. The next proposed package is an explicitly scoped small inspected engineering fixture that must actually exercise charging, replay, durable fallback and attributable native start processing. A small pass would establish only those mechanics. V1 and V2 remain failed at 80 trips. Before any new independent comparison, freeze how acquisition timeouts and timely cold fallback are scored, retain every assigned case and seed, and separate method failures from unknown infrastructure. Cold full solving and strong nonlearned ranking controls remain necessary; a failed constructive control alone cannot establish learning value.
